name: Record carrier claim receipt
goal: Record the shipper-provided carrier confirmation and start the local 30-day acknowledgment and 120-day resolution reminders.

config.template:
Customer-provided carrier receipt confirmation recorded. The 30- and 120-day reminders begin from this reported receipt date.

{summary}

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import os,json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures/freight-claims/reports'; rows=[json.loads(x.read_text()) for x in p.glob('receipt-*.json')]; assert rows and all(r.get('deadline_rule') == '30d|120d' and r.get('carrier_reference') and r.get('side_effects') == [] for r in rows)"
